name: Femboy Inc.
source:
A decent salary and no experience required. After another round of dead-end applications, an offer from Femboy Inc seemed worth taking.
Your new job puts you behind the scenes of adult entertainment: coordinating performers, keeping streams running, and learning how much effort goes into making everything look effortless. Your bosses expect you to pay attention. Unfortunately, there’s plenty to get distracted by.
Get to know  Alex, your demanding supervisor, whose carefully maintained professional image leaves plenty to discover. Spend time with  Mika, an easygoing streamer with a warm smile and an audience you’re a part of. Reconnect with  Hayden, your old gym partner, who remembers your bad habits and enjoys giving you a hard time about them.
translation:
薪水可观，还不要求工作经验。在又一轮投简历石沉大海之后，“伪娘股份公司”发来的录用通知似乎值得一试。
这份新工作将你带到了成人娱乐产业的幕后：协调出镜主播、保障直播顺畅运行，并亲身体会要让台前的一切显得游刃有余究竟得付出多少心血。上司要求你时刻保持专注；只可惜，这里让人分心的诱惑实在太多了。
走近你那位要求严苛的主管亚历克斯——在他精心维持的职业形象背后，藏着太多值得发掘的秘密；陪伴随和开朗的主播米卡——他有着温暖的笑容，而你自己也是他直播间观众中的一员；与昔日的健身搭档海登重逢——他还记得你的种种坏习惯，而且乐此不疲地拿这些事打趣刁难你。
